notes: The compound *So as to* is taken as one rendering of the purpose `לְ` under rule 30's one-rendering-not-one-token reading, headed on *to* (rule 24); the competing reading gives *to* alone to the preposition and marks *So as* `added`, and that alternative is named in the unit's note.
The second colon writes no waw, so its *And* answers to no morpheme and is `added` (rule 14's closing sentences).
Both bracketed `[הַ]` tokens are real morphemes and are marked `unrepresented` where the ASV writes no *the* (rules 12 and 29).
